26.2.1.0.0: First stable release with rituals, brewing, supernatural progression, creatures, diagnostics, optional recipe-viewer integration, translations, and resource-pack overrides.
26.2.1.1.0: Updated 3D models and textures, manuals, item presentation, brews, dolls, ritual feedback, creatures, and stability.
26.2.1.2.0: Adds goblin raids and improved goblin ecology, redesigned Nami and Naamah, responsive mounted broom flight, expanded supernatural manuals and progression, and broad ritual, machine, model, texture, and stability improvements.
26.2.1.2.1: Clarifies manuals and pictograms, repairs Torn Page progression, binds biome books to scalable climate rites, and expands creature and goblin trades.
26.2.1.2.2: Adds complete Simplified Chinese, Russian, Korean, and Turkish localizations, including Fabric-specific tags and biome-note guidance.
26.2.1.3.0: Fortifies villages, adds vampire and werewolf assaults with distinct objectives and transformations, expands hobgoblin defenses, and improves player wolf form.
26.2.1.3.1: Updates the Forge, NeoForge, and Fabric builds to the latest compatible Minecraft 26.2 loader and API releases.
26.2.1.4.0: Makes village assaults rarer, adds mob-specific combat and hazard navigation, expands ecology and settlement life, improves spouse interactions and common-tag compatibility, and aligns tested Forge, NeoForge, and Fabric releases.
26.2.1.5.0: Adds dedicated bounded creature behaviors and mimicry, reimagines machine interfaces, restores and modernizes Witchery machine functionality, expands Nami's Ocean Monument progression, reduces continuous scanning, and aligns Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, and the supporter build.
26.2.1.5.1: Isolates GameTests, reworks vampire blood, Sanguine regeneration, sunlight, and death wards, adds werewolf prey drive and synchronized wolf forms, rebuilds readable creature and magical-plant visuals, and fixes Hobgoblin defensive strikes.
